scope: Static cached GPT reconstruction implementation; no helper import or execution

findings.finding: Parses entries into a compact list, skipping entries with end LBA zero; original empty slot positions are not retained in that list.

Generates a new protective MBR and fixed-format GPT headers/table (512-byte sectors,128 entries of128 bytes,first usable LBA34); CRC regeneration establishes internal consistency, not original byte identity.

Requires userdata at third-from-last compact entry, extends its end to header last usable LBA, clears last two entries and conditionally renames boot_x/recovery_x. It does not compare an independently acquired original map.
Emits backup-table start offset as input last usable LBA plus1; source alone does not validate that against actual disk geometry.
Reparses regenerated primary output, then writes local primary/backup files. This is not device readback or a comparison with original pre-change sectors.
